summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The SMART Trend 25 ETF (STRN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund actively invests in equity securities of 25 US large-cap companies, selected based on price momentum and fundamental analysis. Constituents are market cap-weighted. STRN was launched on Aug 20, 2025 and is issued by Smart.

holdings.infoBox: STRN is an equity ETF with a total of 26 individual holdings. The top holdings are Alphabet stock at 13.93%, Southern Copper at 7.80%, Amphenol at 7.18%, Capital One Financial at 6.19%, and Valero Energy at 5.83%.
